data.text:
Na movement carry us reach here — but na ownership go carry us go far.

@Frontier_DAO don change name – e don turn to Viction Community Growth Engine. No be just rebrand – na full reset to take build community wey go last.

@BuildOnViction dey grow like wild harmattan fire. New people dey enter, new builders dey show face, communities dey spring up steady. Before, na sharp movement and plenty campaign dem dey use keep up. But as e be so now, growth wey go last need structure.

Dem set am now like two-leg system:

🔹 Viction Vanguard – Na for the real plug wey sabi do work.
Mission, bounty, and leaderboard full ground. If person dey show, $VIC plus partner token go land for wallet. Even NFT badge go follow — with plenty level and respect for community.

🔸 Viction Local Chapters – Each one na for ground people wey sabi their area.
Dem know wetin go work for their people, dem know the language, dem know the vibe. From Lagos go Manila, na dem dey carry Viction waka for street.

Current Chapters:  🇵🇭 @VictionPH
🌍 @VictionAFR
🇹🇭 @VictionTH
🇮🇩 @VictionID
🇻🇳 @VictionVN
...more dey load.

This one no be community dem dey build for mouth — na proper system.
From campaign to coordination, from vibes to real contribution.
This na the kind structure wey fit carry Web3 reach every street.

Full tori deh here, https://t.co/DKmMvaDwvf
